title: Corvus voice dataset line
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL). Public examples follow DIOGENES.md or GABE_VOICE.md; anything from personal archives stays in diogenes/private/.

prompt.description: What the model is asked, or the context it replies to. May be an instruction like 'write a post'.

response.description: The target answer in the voice.

source.description: Where the response comes from: 'hicks1925:VI.<section>' for public-domain Diogenes Laertius, 'x:<tweet id>' for Gabe's own X archive, 'manual' for hand-written examples.
